decisions.reason: The existing same-message Event captures the $18 amount and random NFT owner but omits that the commission now applies when a referral is missing or rejected.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For the ' Valid referral number' popup, please apply the following rules:
\- Only NFTs confirmed before checkout should be valid.

\- When the referral is accepted, display: 'Referral accepted! $25 credit + entry into the $2,000 reward drawing for your chosen referrer.'

\- When the referral is missing or rejected, display: 'Referral unavailable! $18 commission and a $900 draw entry will be assigned to a random NFT owner.'

decisions.reason: The accepted-referral commission change is already represented by a complete same-message Event; the no-referral ticket allocation change requires no additional propagation.
The accepted-referral popup mentions entry into a $2,000 drawing, but it is unclear whether this changes the existing ticket count or mechanics or only specifies display copy.
The source changes referral-popup rules and does not require a change to the approved FAQ content.
The source addresses referral-popup behavior, not the About-page content or prize descriptions.
Assigning a no-referral draw entry to a random NFT owner does not change how book access, referral identity, badges, or active tickets behave after an NFT transfer.
The source adds referral-validity and fallback-allocation rules but does not change the token-serial referral identity or its display locations.
The source changes allocation of a draw entry and does not alter automatic prize payout or claim behavior.
Changing when and to whom a no-referral entry is allocated does not change Small Block ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, or reset behavior.
The source retains a $900 draw entry and does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility, or pool allocation.
The referral-popup rules do not necessarily change the landing-page copy or layout.
The fallback recipient and trigger change does not alter the required metadata counters, badges, or referral-code attributes.
